title: A király halála (The King's Death)
grammar: The King's Fate: megfulladt, elhunyt, menekülő

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can narrate the tragedy of King Louis II in the swollen Csele brook.
I can explain the dynastic crisis and double king election caused by his childless demise.
I can use megfulladt, elhunyt and menekülő to describe people in a historical event.
I can use the new vocabulary about the death of the king and the succession.
